Select: Any size works: both sides are multiples of 16, at least 256, at most 6144 patches (width/16 × height/16), for example 1536×1024. Select: Pick your own .safetensors file made for Anima (kohya, diffusers/PEFT, LoKr and LoHa formats; 28 or 40 blocks). It is checked as soon as you pick it. Strength 1.00 is the author's setting. A Turbo LoRA and a regular LoRA can be used together: they are folded into the weights in one pass. Folding happens on load: the first picture with a new set (or a new strength) waits about 12-13 s, with the status "Preparing the LoRA…". The folded weights are kept as 8-bit blocks (about 2 GB of storage) for the last set only: going back to an earlier set takes those seconds again. The text-encoder part of a LoRA is not applied.

選択: MOSS-Image用の自分の .safetensors ファイルを選んでください（FLUX、SDXLなど他のモデル用LoRAは使えません）。選択するとすぐに確認され、合わない場合はアプリが理由を表示します。強さ1.00は作者の設定です：低いと弱く、高いと強くなります。新しいLoRAまたは新しい強さでの最初の画像は、準備に約15秒かかります（一時ファイル約300 MB）。スロットはランク128までのLoRAを受け付け、LoRAを1つ使うとターボスロットが置き換わります。LoRAの利用は作者のライセンスに従います。
